headline: VoiceStudio offers local voice suite in 646 languages
lede: Users can do voice design, dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobook creation fully locally.

effects.effect: Local audio pipelines replace hosted voice APIs

with.title: Hyperframes turns agent-written HTML into video
Bedrock adds structured outputs across Claude models
Measured: HTML costs far more tokens than markdown

possibilities.connection: Strict JSON from Claude on Bedrock fills a fixed HTML template, which avoids the measured high token cost of free-form HTML; Hyperframes renders that HTML to video and VoiceStudio adds local voiceover per language.

with.title: Self-hosted AI call center with realtime voice bots

possibilities.connection: A local voice suite in 646 languages, a self-hosted call center with bot-to-human handoff, and a very fast cheap diffusion LLM together make low-latency multilingual phone service possible without sending audio to a hosted API.

appearances.headline: VoiceStudio clones voices and dubs video locally
appearances.newly_possible: You can clone voices, dub video, transcribe and make audiobooks fully on your own machine, in a claimed 646 languages.
appearances.why: It offers a local alternative to a paid voice service for teams with privacy or cost limits.
appearances.limits: The 646-language claim is untested here, and quality is not shown.
